answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral. If evidence shows k identities coordinated an equivocation, pairwise penalties scale with k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), rather than imposing only a flat per-key fine. Detection also compounds asymmetric depreciation across the swarm, so the fraction of redeemable capital lost rises exponentially with k. Copper-trace audit records, prism-separated commitments, and pigment-tagged escrow lots support attribution and enforcement.
